column4: sw_vers; uname -m; sysctl -n machdep.cpu.brand_string; sysctl -n hw.memsize; java -version; /usr/libexec/java_home -V; xcodebuild -version; xcrun --show-sdk-version --sdk iphonesimulator; .venv/bin/python --version; git --version; (command -v gh && gh --version) || echo "gh: not installed"; (command -v gh >/dev/null && gh auth status >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "gh: authenticated") || echo "gh: not authenticated"

git fetch origin --prune && git log --oneline -12 origin/main && git rev-parse origin/main && (git worktree list | grep -q "$WT" || git worktree add -B "$BRANCH" "$WT" origin/main) && git -C "$WT" status --short --branch && git -C "$WT" log --oneline -1

command -v gh >/dev/null || { echo "gh not installed"; exit 2; }; gh pr list --state all --limit 12; echo; gh run list --limit 40 --json databaseId,workflowName,headBranch,event,status,conclusion,createdAt,url; echo; for id in $(gh run list --limit 8 --json databaseId -q ".[].databaseId"); do echo "--- run $id"; gh run view $id --json jobs -q ".jobs[] | [.name,.conclusion,(.steps|length)] | @tsv"; done
xcodebuild -project iosApp.xcodeproj -scheme iosApp -configuration Debug -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO ARCHS=arm64 build
xcodebuild -project iosApp.xcodeproj -scheme iosApp -configuration Release -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath build-release CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO ARCHS=arm64 build
xcodebuild -project iosApp.xcodeproj -scheme iosApp -configuration Release -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' -derivedDataPath build-device CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build

find composeApp/build/outputs -name "*.apk" -o -name "*.aab" | xargs ls -l; BT=$(ls -d "$ANDROID_HOME"/build-tools/* | sort -V | tail -1); echo "build-tools: $BT"; for a in composeApp/build/outputs/apk/*/*.apk; do echo "=== $a"; "$BT/aapt2" dump badging "$a" | grep -E "^(package|sdkVersion|targetSdkVersion|application-label|application-icon|application:|launchable-activity|uses-permission|locales|densities|native-code)"; "$BT/apksigner" verify --print-certs "$a" 2>&1 | grep -v -i "sha-256\|sha-1\|md5" | head -5; done; for d in iosApp/build iosApp/build-release iosApp/build-device; do find $d/Build/Products -maxdepth 2 -name "*.app" -exec du -sk {} \; 2>/dev/null; done; APP=$(find iosApp/build-release/Build/Products -maxdepth 2 -name "*.app" | head -1); [ -n "$APP" ] && { plutil -p "$APP/Info.plist"; ls -la "$APP"; ls "$APP"/*.lproj 2>/dev/null; }
$ANDROID_HOME/platform-tools/adb devices -l; "$ANDROID_HOME/emulator/emulator" -list-avds; xcrun simctl list devices available | head -40

ADB="$ANDROID_HOME/platform-tools/adb"; PKG=io.github.alexeykravtsov95.talentforge.devcheck; ACT=io.github.alexeykravtsov95.talentforge.ui.MainActivity; ./gradlew --console=plain --no-configuration-cache :composeApp:assembleDebug -Ptalentforge.applicationIdSuffix=.devcheck || exit 1; $ADB shell getprop ro.product.model; $ADB shell getprop ro.build.version.release; $ADB shell getprop persist.sys.locale; $ADB install -r -t composeApp/build/outputs/apk/debug/composeApp-debug.apk; $ADB shell pm clear $PKG; $ADB logcat -c; for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do $ADB shell am force-stop $PKG; sleep 2; $ADB shell am start -W -n $PKG/$ACT | grep -E "Status|LaunchState|TotalTime|WaitTime"; sleep 4; done; $ADB exec-out screencap -p > "<repo>/.tf-transfer/rc1/evidence/71-android-first-launch.png"; $ADB shell dumpsys meminfo $PKG | sed -n 1,45p; echo "--- crash buffer"; $ADB logcat -d -b crash | tail -40; echo "--- AndroidRuntime"; $ADB logcat -d | grep -E "AndroidRuntime|FATAL" | tail -20; $ADB uninstall $PKG; echo "isolated .devcheck package uninstalled; the regular app was not touched"
